Interface CommandContext

All Known Implementing Classes:
ChatShell
public interface CommandContext
The CommandContext type is the set of resources one command may use. The chat shell implements the type for the connection that typed the command. The shell supplies the session, the writers, the model selection, and the request to close.

  • Method Details

    • getSession

      ChatSession getSession()
      The getSession method returns the chat session for this connection.
      Returns:
      The ChatSession bound to this connection.

    • getShellMode

      ShellMode getShellMode()
      The getShellMode method returns the current shell mode. The mode says whether Enter sends a chat turn, runs a command, or stays idle.
      Returns:
      The current ShellMode.

    • getProperties

      CasseroleProperties getProperties()
      The getProperties method returns the bound program configuration.
      Returns:
      The CasseroleProperties for this process.

    • getModelName

      String getModelName()
      The getModelName method returns the configured Ollama model name. Ollama is the program that runs a local model. The result stays the Ollama id even when another family is selected.
      Returns:
      The configured Ollama model name, when that name is known.

    • getConsoleThink

      String getConsoleThink()
      The getConsoleThink method returns the think string for this console. The think string is the setting that asks the model to expose its reasoning. The empty string means that setting is off. The string is not a column in the conversation store.
      Returns:
      The trimmed think string, or the empty string when thinking is off.

    • getConsoleProvider

      String getConsoleProvider()
      The getConsoleProvider method returns the family word for this console. The family word is ollama, grok, or pool. The missing word is reported as ollama.
      Returns:
      The family word, or ollama when no other family is stored.

    • writeModelStatus

      void writeModelStatus()
      The writeModelStatus method prints the selected family, the target, and that family's stored options. getModelName() stays the Ollama id while this method prints the selected family.

    • selectConsoleFamily

      boolean selectConsoleFamily(String family)
      The selectConsoleFamily method switches the console family. The accepted words are ollama, grok, and pool. The stored options for each family stay in place. An unknown word writes nothing and is not stored.
      Parameters:
      family - The family word to store.
      Returns:
      true when the family was stored, or false when the word was not stored.

    • getSshUsername

      String getSshUsername()
      The getSshUsername method returns the SSH login name for this connection. SSH is the secure-shell protocol the client used to connect. The empty string means no login name is stored.
      Returns:
      The SSH login name, or the empty string.

    • getProcessor

      CommandProcessor getProcessor()
      The getProcessor method returns the processor that owns this command set. help uses that processor to list and look up commands.
      Returns:
      The CommandProcessor for this connection.

    • write

      void write(String text)
      The write method sends default-color text to the VT100 standard output. VT100 is the terminal control set the chat shell paints with. The method does not add a carriage return or a line feed.
      Parameters:
      text - The text to write.

    • writeError

      void writeError(String text)
      The writeError method sends one error line in red. The implementation adds the color and the newline.
      Parameters:
      text - The message to write.

    • setChatActive

      void setChatActive(boolean active)
      The setChatActive method switches this connection between chat and idle. chat start and chat stop call this method. If active is true, later Enter lines may go to the language model. The language model is the program that writes the assistant reply. If active is false, Enter does not call the language model.
      Parameters:
      active - true when chat turns should go to the language model, or false when they should not.

    • requestExit

      void requestExit()
      The requestExit method closes the SSH session after the command returns. SSH is the secure-shell protocol the client used to connect.

    • setModelName

      void setModelName(String modelName)
      The setModelName method stores the live model name for this shell. The swap command calls this method when the console family is Ollama. // @aa-sdd G-15 aetheris-stages-1-3.finalize.md
      Parameters:
      modelName - The Ollama model tag to store.

    • collectMessageEdit

      void collectMessageEdit(long seq)
      The collectMessageEdit method reads following lines as the body of message edit. Reading stops at a line whose text is <.>. The seq value is the stored sequence number of the message to revise.
      Parameters:
      seq - The stored sequence number of the message to revise.
